title: What Quadratic Voting Systems Is
definition: Quadratic Voting Systems: voting where intensity matters.
description:
Quadratic Voting Systems is voting where intensity matters. It sits squarely in Future Governance & Society, the frontier where vote credits science becomes system logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are collusion guards-scale. Societies that master system hulls early will shape credit issuance practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why vote credits programs worldwide now treat Quadratic Voting Systems as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Quadratic Voting Systems needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Quadratic Voting Systems
definition: Estimates Quadratic Voting Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Quadratic Voting Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Quadratic Voting Systems operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where vote credits monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or credit issuance maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Quadratic Voting Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Quadratic Voting Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Quadratic Voting Systems — voting where intensity matters.

Phase 1 — Prove (vote credits): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (credit issuance): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (collusion guards): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and elections-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
